data.title: Tokyo & Beyond
data.subtitle: Wisteria, Fuji Views & Vegetarian Feasts During Golden Week
data.description: A 5-day adventure for two vegetarian travelers — gentle jetlag recovery, iconic Tokyo culture, a day trip to Kamakura, overnight near Mt Fuji with private onsen, and Ashikaga Flower Park at peak wisteria. All during Golden Week, with budget-smart tips.
data.bestFor: Vegetarian foodies, nature lovers, culture & architecture enthusiasts
highlights: Ashikaga Flower Park at peak wisteria
Ghibli Museum & Edo-Tokyo Open Air Museum

essentials.title: ⚠️ Golden Week Alert
essentials.text: Your trip overlaps with Golden Week (Apr 29–May 5) — Japan's biggest holiday. Expect larger crowds, packed trains, and higher prices. Book teamLab Borderless, Ghibli Museum, and ryokan NOW. The upside? Festive atmosphere, special events, and wisteria at peak bloom.

essentials.title: 🥬 Vegetarian Survival Guide
essentials.text: Japan can be tricky for vegetarians — dashi (fish stock) hides in many dishes. Say "watashi wa bejitarian desu" (I am vegetarian) and "niku, sakana, dashi nashi de onegaishimasu" (no meat, fish, or dashi please). Konbini are lifesavers: umeboshi/kombu onigiri, inari sushi, edamame are always veggie-safe. We curated 100% vegetarian-verified restaurants for every meal.

essentials.title: 🚃 Getting Around
essentials.text: Get a 72-hour Tokyo Metro pass (¥1,500/person) for Days 1-3. For day trips, use a Suica/Pasmo IC card loaded with ¥5,000 each. Haneda to central Tokyo is ~30 min via Keikyu Line (¥500).

essentials.title: 💴 Budget Tips
essentials.text: Under ¥70,000 per person for 5 days is tight during Golden Week but doable. Budget hotels (¥5,000-8,000/night). Konbini breakfast (¥300-500), casual lunch (¥800-1,200), one nice dinner daily (¥2,000-3,000). Free attractions: Meiji Shrine, Imperial Palace, Yoyogi Park. Biggest expenses: Kawaguchiko overnight and day trip trains.

essentials.title: 📱 Stay Connected
essentials.text: Grab a prepaid eSIM before you fly (Ubigi, Airalo, or Sakura Mobile — ¥2,000-3,000 for 5 days unlimited). Google Maps works perfectly for train navigation.

essentials.title: ✈️ Airport Logistics
essentials.text: Arrive Haneda Mon Apr 27 at 13:55. Immigration + baggage ~45-60 min. At hotel by ~16:00. Departure May 2 at 19:40 — leave hotel by 16:30, at Haneda by 17:30 for international check-in.
